title: Make a Legacy Data Source Main-safe
prompt: Wrap blocking file and CPU-heavy parsing operations behind one main-safe suspend API with injected dispatchers and deterministic tests.
successCriteria: Main callers never execute blocking I/O.
Context switches occur only around owned work.
Tests use replaceable dispatchers on one scheduler.
hints: Write down the ownership and failure contract before choosing library APIs.
Prove one adverse or lifecycle case before improving presentation.

starterCode.code: class ArticleSource(private val io: CoroutineDispatcher, private val cpu: CoroutineDispatcher)

solutionOutline: Model immutable inputs, outputs, events, and failures at the boundary.
Implement the smallest correct path and verify every success criterion.
verification: Run deterministic state or protocol tests.
Inspect the relevant accessibility, lifecycle, concurrency, or network boundary.
